title: The Global Quest for Sustainable Urban Mobility
subtitle: Exploring the shift from car-centric infrastructure to human-centered urban design.
description: This series examines how global cities are redesigning transit systems to reduce carbon emissions and improve quality of life. It provides a comprehensive look at the policy, technology, and social changes required to move beyond the private automobile.

articles.label: Part 1
articles.note: Explaining the historical shift toward highway expansion and the resulting urban sprawl.

articles.label: Part 2
articles.note: Identifying the institutions and local governments leading the change.

articles.label: Part 3
articles.note: Focusing on the explosion of e-bikes, scooters, and bike-sharing programs.

articles.label: Part 4
articles.note: Analyzing the impact of transit changes on public health and social equality.

articles.label: Part 5
articles.note: Discussing the future of autonomous vehicles and the funding gap for transit.
